description: This file defines the EmploymentContractService class within the OrangeHRM system, handling operations related to employment contract attachments for employees, such as retrieving, saving, and deleting contract-related documents.

classes.name: EmploymentContractService
classes.description: Service class providing operations for managing employee employment contract attachments within the HRM system.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the EmploymentContractDao instance used for database operations.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the EmployeeAttachmentService instance responsible for handling employee attachment logic.

methods.name: getContractAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the latest contract attachment for a given employee number. Returns null if none found.

methods.name: getContractAttachmentById
methods.description: Fetches a specific contract attachment by attachment ID for a given employee.

methods.name: saveContractAttachment
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeAttachment object as a contract attachment, setting its screen to contract.

methods.name: deleteContractAttachment
methods.description: Deletes a given EmployeeAttachment from the system.
